title: Dragon Ball Super Remake Wraps Battle of Gods Arc With Epic Finale Fight
content: Dragon Ball Super ‘s big remake anime series has now reached the end of the Battle of Gods arc with its latest episode, and fans got a newly enhanced version of the final fight with Beerus as a result.
author: ComicBook

title: 34% of Developers in 2026 GDC Survey Were Laid Off in Last 2 Years
content: The Game Developers Conference (GDC) released the results of its 15th annual "State of the Game Industry Survey" last Thursday and revealed that 34% of game developers surveyed were laid off in the last 24 months, up from 28% last year. Of that 34%, 68% stated they were laid off in the last 12 months.

title: Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san? Anime Unveils Main Visual
content: A main visual was unveiled for the upcoming Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san? anime. Studio SynergySP is animating the series with Yasuaki Fujii as director. It is set to premiere on January 7, 2027. A teaser trailer was previously released.

title: Skip and Loafer Season 2 Reveals New Key Visual, New Trailer
content: The previously announced Skip and Loafer Season 2 revealed a key visual and a new trailer on Monday. Additionally, Reina Ueda and Yuto Takenaka will join the voice cast as Chieri Yasaka and Kiyohiko Ujiie, respectively. Studio P.A. Works will continue to animate the series, set to premiere in April 2027.

title: Märchen Crown Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content: This year's 50th issue of Shueisha 's Young Jump magazine announced on Thursday Aka Akasaka , Aoi Kujira , and Ajichika 's Märchen Crown manga will end in the next issue on November 19. The manga debuted in Young Jump in March 2025.

title: 'Skip to Loafer 2nd Season' Reveals Additional Cast Pair, First Promo
content: • The official website for the Skip to Loafer ( Skip and Loafer ) television anime revealed an additional pair of cast, new key visual, and the first promotional video for the Season 2 on Monday. The second season adapting Misaki Takamatsu 's coming-of-age manga will premiere in April 2027.
